description:
Everything about the power in your home — told by an old lineman who spent 40 years keeping the lights on.

When the street goes dark, Cal gives plain answers: what to do, why it works, and how to check it at your own house in about a minute.

On this channel:
- Getting through an outage safely, especially if you live alone
- Why your power blinks and who gets it back first
- Generators, space heaters, downed lines, carbon monoxide
- The great storms and blackouts, and what people learned from them

New videos every week.

"Every wire's hot till you ground it yourself." Test it before you trust it.

Panel and generator wiring is a job for a licensed electrician. If a CO alarm goes off, get out and call 911. Sources are in every video description.

Cal Slone is a fictional narrator created with AI voice and visuals. His stories are dramatized; the safety facts are real.
